issue.title: complete_themes shell-completion test runs on the 150 ms production deadline and flakes under suite load

task_type_fields.evidence:
Two independent observations during epic bob-cli-fe. bob-cli-fe.2 note #1 (around d712168f) saw it fail singly in full tests/cli runs and pass in isolation. bob-cli-fe.4 note #2 (around bb92fb1c) saw it fail once under parallel `just check`, missing "your type · never used", and pass in isolation. It has not reproduced serially, and the bob-cli-fe land agent's `just check` on aeb9674d passed it.

Likely root cause (source audit at aeb9674d): the file-local `command()` helper in tests/cli/capture/complete_themes.rs (line 6) builds on `bob_command()`, not `bob_completion_command()` (tests/cli/support.rs:136). As a result, `bob __complete zsh -- bob capture =#` runs on the 150 ms production COMPLETE_DEADLINE_MS (src/native/completion/mod.rs:34). Under suite load, the theme-history scan misses that deadline, and the shell rows lose their "your type · never used" description. bob-cli-f2 tracks the same omission in tests/cli/articles.rs.

Fix: set BOB_COMPLETE_DEADLINE_MS through the shared helper, for example by starting `command()` from `bob_completion_command()`. Leave the production default unchanged. Then run the complete_themes module in isolation and under full-suite load.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (parallel cargo test --workspace); passes with cargo test --test cli capture::complete_themes

issue.creation_reason: Two bob-cli-fe phase workers saw this completion test fail under parallel load and pass alone. No bead tracked it. The fix is a one-line helper change that bob-cli-f2 does not cover.

payload.description: Same unpinned completion-deadline omission in the tests/cli/articles.rs helper; fix both the same way
